incidents.name: OmniEstate invest parameter validation
incidents.notes: The OmniEstate contract's invest() accepts a caller-supplied amount without checking it against the tokens actually transferred in, so the attacker booked a large investment for nothing and withdrew the ORT proceeds.

sources.ref: onchain review: OmniEstate 0x6f40A3d0c89cFfdC8A1af212A019C220A295E9bB created 2021-12-14T01:19:59Z by 0xd993af5263dcd70b6991fa31e1fe247f9cd3208f, unrelated to attack sender 0x9bbd94506398a1459f0cd3b2638512627390255e; three EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last at 1647953316 (2022-03-22T11:28:36Z), which is the basis for the age. Loss converted from the reported 236 BNB: 236 BNB x $297.87 at incidentTimestamp 1673916860 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $70,297.
